title: dryopteris nidus
intro: Dryopteris nidus, commonly known as the Spiny Woodfern, is a species of fern native to Asia and parts of Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, helping to alleviate digestive issues, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris nidus include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
